_comment: PurpClaw safe default config. Copy to purpclaw.config.json and edit. Demo mode works with NO keys.

provider._comment: In demo mode no key is needed. For api/local mode set one provider + key in .env.

services._comment: Core services started by `safe-start --core`. Optional ones are off by default.
